reviews.text: We just brought our 17-year-old poodle in and he gave her a perfect haircut at a very reasonable price.

I'm thrilled with Jennifer. She's incredibly professional and always leaves my poodle looking perfect: clean, perfectly groomed, and gorgeous. Plus, you can really see the love she has for the dogs, and that's so appreciated. ❤️ We'll definitely be back.

We went for the first time and it was fantastic! Jennifer is super friendly and you can tell she's very loving with dogs, plus she made my baby look gorgeous. Thank you!! I recommend her without hesitation.

We're thrilled with Jennifer! Our furry friend comes out looking gorgeous and with a special glow. Not only that, we feel completely at ease leaving him there because we know how well cared for he is.
Very happy. It was my first time there and the service for both me and my little one was exceptional. 100% recommended.

Highly recommended dog groomer.
From the moment you arrive until you leave, everything is very natural, simple, and friendly… a true professional who loves her work.
It was my first time going with my dog ​​Kiro, and we left delighted.
Thank you so much, Jennifer!

Jennifer, thank you!! My dog ​​had dead hair for years without anyone saying anything to me. She explained and advised me, and of course, she left my dog ​​Neu looking SPOTLESS. What a fantastic job, and at a super reasonable price. I recommend her 100%, she's super professional.
